_comment: Board action -> huaxu line title, per frame (slug). Read by build_voices.py. Titles are exactly as the frame's huaxu voices page spells them. A clip with no line chosen has no entry. Qu's data holds no clip <-> line link (checked: the voices page payload and the manifests' eventTables), so these pairs were chosen by listening: each clip played with its candidate line in Playground, by the user. Audio length (taken by decoding the file: ffprobe overestimates these VBR MP3s up to 2x) only narrows the choice, but the pairs agree with it: every line ends before its clip except Shukra's BoardAct1004, which outlasts it by 0.1 s (41.9 s against 41.8 s).
